artworks.title: Landscape with Group of Trees Surrounded by Water
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting by a campfire near a tranquil body of water, surrounded by dense foliage. Trees line the horizon and reflect in the water. The detailed brushstrokes create a textured appearance. The color palette is mostly sepia, giving a timeless feel. Ripples on the water mirror the natural elements in the scene.

artworks.title: Oriental with Beard, Reading a Book
artworks.description: The image is an illustrated scene showing a seated figure of a person with a full-length view from head to toe. The individual is positioned sitting with legs extended forward and slightly bent, holding a large book open across their lap and engrossed in reading. The person's facial features are detailed, with a beard and hair obscured by a rounded hat. They wear long flowing clothing, draping around their seated form. There are no visible items of jewelry. In the background, the setting appears to be outdoors, suggested by a tree branch overhead. A globe-like object sits on a pedestal behind the person, and lines radiate from the book.

artworks.title: Old Cottages
artworks.description: The image features a village scene with a thatched-roof cottage in the foreground, followed by more rustic buildings along a path. The horizon shows more buildings and trees. The etching style uses delicate lines and shading with a monochromatic color palette. A couple is seen walking on the path, with trees and structures in the distance.

artworks.title: Knight in Armor on Horseback
artworks.description: The image shows a person on horseback holding a long object. The individual has a mustache, a helmet with a plume, and elaborate clothing resembling a military uniform. The background includes rocky formations and sparse vegetation, with an illustrative style.

artworks.title: Tilemakers
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals in different poses and attire. The central figure stands holding a long-handled tool. To the left, a person is seated, leaning on a wooden structure. To the right, two individuals are busy handling wooden tools or blocks on a stone table. The background features a stone wall with additional tools or containers.

artworks.title: Study of a Tree
artworks.description: The image depicts a large, gnarled tree dominating the scene from an eye level perspective. The horizon is indicated beneath the tree's lower branches by a line of clouds. Fine lines suggest billowing cumulus clouds in the sky. The illustration style uses detailed black ink lines to show the tree's twisted bark. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink against white paper for contrast. A human figure is seated at the base of the tree.

artworks.title: Landscape with Trees, Girl Crossing Footbridge
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with trees and hills in the distance. The horizon is above the trees on the left, with birds flying above. Delicate etching-like lines give detail to the foliage, a person on a bridge, and the scene. The color palette is predominantly sepia or black-and-white. Closest to us, a person stands on a wooden bridge looking at animals in the water. Lush vegetation surrounds the bridge, and a path leads to sheep grazing in the distance.

artworks.title: Shepherd with Dog and Sheep
artworks.description: The image shows a man reclining on the ground, with one hand on his chest and the other shielding his eyes. He is surrounded by a group of sheep and a dog sitting next to him. In the background, there are hilly formations, trees, and shrubs. The artwork features intricate line work with varying thickness for textures and shading. The image is in monochromatic tones, using black lines on a beige background.

artworks.title: Landscape with Men in Armor, Tree Stump
artworks.description: The image is an ink or pen drawing viewed from an elevated angle. The scene features intricate line work depicting a landscape with two figures in armor under a large tree. In the distance, mountain peaks can be seen. The drawing is monochromatic, focusing on black and white contrasts.

artworks.title: Ruined Abbey among Trees
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from an elevated perspective, featuring a serene natural setting with dense foliage and trees dominating the scene. An old structure with Gothic-style arches sits among the trees to the right. The meticulous brushstrokes create intricate textures in the trees and ruins, typical of an etching style. The color palette is monochromatic, using variations of black on a light background for shadows and depth. Two figures rest on the grassy bank near a winding stream that flows from the center of the scene. More trees line the background, enhancing the sense of enclosure and tranquility.

artworks.title: Oriental Woman, Holding a Torch
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a person in a side profile, holding a lit torch in their right hand. The person has a facial profile with delicate features, with partially visible hair below a hood. They wear a long cloak or robe with a hood that covers their head and drapes over their shoulders. The person's face is partially covered by the hood, showing only the eyes and nose. The robe is loose-fitting with draped folds. The background is shaded with diagonal lines.

artworks.title: Horse and Cart in Quarry
artworks.description: The image is a detailed pen-and-ink drawing of a rustic rural scene. It shows a man with two horses pulling a cart, a dog beside him, and another figure seated nearby. Surrounding them are trees and vegetation, creating a sense of enclosure and harmony with nature.

artworks.title: Landscape with Deer under Trees
artworks.description: The image shows a view from within a grove of trees, with the viewer looking out through foliage towards the left. The horizon is positioned low, showcasing flat land in the distance with a faint suggestion of a structure or landmark on the left side. The trees are depicted with detailed brushstrokes creating texture and depth. The monochromatic palette of black ink on a cream background emphasizes contrast. Close to us, the roots and trunks of trees are captured with flowing lines, with animals, possibly cattle, seen in the distance. The sky is hinted at through unmarked space among the leaves.

artworks.title: Angel of the Resurrection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure in a dynamic pose set amidst swirling lines. The figure portrays a human-like form with large wings, outstretched arms, and flowing garments. The background features textured patterns suggesting foliage and sky. At the bottom is the caption "He is not here: for he is risen."

artworks.title: The Lost Apple
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in profile to the left. She is dressed in a flowing gown with an apron, and a bonnet covering her hair. She holds a round object close to her torso. Beside her, a child peeks over a doorway. There is a bench in front of the door. The background has swirling patterns resembling foliage, with a small patch of sky and a cloud to the right.

artworks.title: Landscape with Old Trees by Water
artworks.artist: Henry Richard Greville, 3rd earl of Warwick
artworks.description: The image shows a tree dominating the right side, with a natural, wooded area sloping down into a water body on the left side. The artwork uses detailed linework typical of etching, creating textures and depth. It has a monochromatic color palette of black and white. A figure is seen standing on a rocky outcrop extending into the water in the distance. Subtle hints of other trees and a continuation of the natural setting are visible in the background through fine lines.

artworks.title: Charge
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cavalry charge scene. It depicts horses and riders galloping over rough terrain with spears held firmly as they advance. The horses are mid-leap, their bodies angled forward, mane and tail flowing in motion. The sketch details the animals' muscular structure and the garments of the riders. In the background, there are sketches suggesting chaos and motion, possibly indicating a battlefield environment. The monochrome use of line and shade gives the drawing a dynamic quality.

artworks.title: Landscape with Large Trees
artworks.description: The image shows a nature scene with a sloping terrain among trees. There is no visible horizon line, with the view mainly composed of the rising slope and trees. The trees are depicted with diagonal brushstrokes, giving a textured appearance to their bark and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of black and white. A cloaked figure is seen sitting by a tree trunk, partially in shadow. The landscape extends upwards with dense trees and foliage, leading the eye through the canopies.

artworks.title: A Woman Sitting by the Window
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 23.5 x 31.9 cm (9 1/4 x 12 9/16 in.)
overall (mat size): 40.6 x 55.9 cm (16 x 22 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a black and white illustration of a woman from a three-quarter view, seated on a bench or chair. She is oriented with her back to the viewer, showcasing her body from head to knees. One leg is extended, and one arm is resting across the chair's back. The woman's head is turned, displaying an updo hairstyle. She wears a dress with puffed sleeves, intricate cuff patterns, and a bracelet on her arm. The background includes patterned curtains with floral designs, a pillow on the seat beside her, and a partially visible window with decorative curtains to the side.

artworks.title: Old Tree
artworks.description: The image depicts a large, ancient tree tilted to the left with thick, gnarled branches extending upwards and outwards. The perspective is angled slightly upward, emphasizing the tree's height. In the distance, there is an outline of an architectural structure. The etching style shows intricate lines detailing the bark and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, using black ink on paper. Close to the tree, there is undergrowth with small plants and flowers.

artworks.title: Eastern Patriarch
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a man's body shown in a dramatic pose. He is positioned with his upper body leaning slightly forward, and his right arm is raised, with the hand touching his head. His facial features are pronounced with deep lines and shadows, accentuating his furrowed brow and closed eyes. His hair is long and wavy, and he has a thick, flowing beard. He is wearing a loose-fitting garment with a visible belt around his chest area. In the background, there is a sketch of a landscape featuring distant mountains and what appears to be ancient ruins, with the sky filled with horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Cavalry Charging
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cavalry charge scene. It shows several horses galloping across a makeshift bridge. The central figure is on horseback, holding a sword. The background includes dynamic lines and shapes indicating smoke and cannon fire.

artworks.title: Young Boy Seated
artworks.description: The image shows a young person sitting on the ground in a casual pose. They have short, tousled hair and are wearing a loose shirt, a vest, and short trousers. The person is barefoot and is positioned on a textured surface resembling grass or natural ground, with some foliage around. The background is plain, focusing on the figure.

artworks.title: Resting, Men and Dogs under a Big Tree
artworks.description: The image is a monochrome illustration viewed from a low vantage point, featuring a large tree dominating the right side. The horizon is low with trees and hills in the distance. The intricate brushwork creates texture in the tree's bark and foliage, adding depth. The color palette is black and white, enhancing contrast and emphasizing patterns and shading. Near the tree's base, a person reclines, with two figures sitting slightly further away. In the distance, more trees and undulating land are depicted with detailed linework.
